text: DeepSeek Dock 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端的界面插件，在侧边栏加入常驻且可自定义排序的 Dock，并提供草稿首页、跨工作区置顶会话和右侧文件面板视频预览。用户可以调整导航入口、在发送前编写消息草稿、集中打开重要会话，并在对话旁播放视频。插件通过 Harness 的界面插槽和会话、文件服务接入；源码未声明运行所需的 API 密钥或外部账号。适合希望集中导航、整理会话并在 Harness 中查看生成视频的用户。

DeepSeek Dock adds a customizable sidebar, draft-first Home, cross-workspace pinned chats, and right-panel video previews to DeepSeek Harness. It uses Harness UI, session, and file services. No API keys or external accounts are declared in the inspected runtime.
想把常用的 Harness 导航入口固定在侧边栏，还能自己排序。
能不能把不同工作区的重要会话集中置顶，方便快速打开？
I want to draft a message on the home screen and choose a workspace and model before sending.
DeepSeek Dock 的功能「可定制侧边 Dock」：在 Harness 侧边栏展示导航入口，用户可调整入口并保存显示偏好。偏好保存在本地浏览器存储中，Dock 最多直接显示六项。
DeepSeek Dock 的功能「跨工作区置顶会话」：把 Harness 已置顶且未归档的会话集中列出，点击可打开会话，也可从列表取消置顶。

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · DeepSeek Dock：`0.1.2` · Supported hosts: **macOS / Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 or 0.2.2-rc.1** · Third-party community plugin

[Install](#install) · [Features](#features) · [Compatibility and limits](#compatibility-and-limits) · [Migration](docs/MIGRATION.md) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/captainyufei/dsh-dock/issues)

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Features：| Feature | What changes in everyday use |
|---|---|
| **Persistent, customizable Dock** | Switch between Home, scheduled tasks, and plugins even with the chat list collapsed. Choose the entries you use and drag them into your preferred order. |
| **Codex-inspired UI** | Home, chats, plugins, and scheduled tasks share one window frame and draggable top strip. Moving between pages keeps the same navigation and tool controls, with DeepSeek branding and the native chat hierarchy. |
| **Cross-workspace pins** | Find important chats from different workspaces in one pinned section. Each appears only once; unpinning returns it to its original group without changing workspace membership. |
| **Draft-first Home** | Compose and revise before committing to a chat. A chat is created only when you send, so unsent ideas do not fill the sidebar with empty entries. |
| **Video in the file panel** | Play and seek a generated video on the right while checking the conversation beside it. Reopening the tool drawer restores existing tabs so you can continue reviewing the same content. |

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Install：Requires **macOS / Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 or 0.2.2-rc.1**. Disable the old `@local/chatgpt-rail` plugin first if installed ([migration](docs/MIGRATION.md)). This package is not published to npm; use the repository URL below. No manual build is needed.

This installs the latest code on `main`, not the latest stable release. Installed copies do not update automatically.

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Install in DeepSeek Harness：Open **Plugins → Add plugin**, paste this into **Package name or address**, and click **Install**: ```text https://github.com/captainyufei/dsh-dock ``` When **Installed** appears, click **Enable now**. Closing the dialog instead leaves the plugin switched off.

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Install in DeepSeek Harness：Confirm **DeepSeek Dock** is on under **Installed plugins**. Collapse the chat list: Home, scheduled tasks, and plugins should remain in the left Dock. Right-click the Dock to customize its entries.

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Install with the `dsh` CLI：For the **web profile**, run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/captainyufei/dsh-dock
```

Start `dsh web` if it is not already running, then open **Plugins** and make sure DeepSeek Dock is enabled. The command targets the web profile; desktop users should use the installation dialog above.

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Update or remove：Save your work first. If your plugin manager offers **Update** for DeepSeek Dock, use it, then follow any reload/restart notice. Otherwise uninstall the plugin and reinstall using the same repository URL or CLI command above, then enable it. Confirm version **0.1.2 or newer** in the plugin details. Reopening Harness alone does not fetch new code.

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Update or remove：```text
   /Users/alex/Plugins/dsh-dock
   ```

Use your actual folder path, not the example or the ZIP file.
4. Click **Install → Enable now**, and check the Dock as described above. Keep the local directory after installation.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Troubleshooting installation</summary>

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Update or remove：| Problem | Next step |
|---|---|
| Package not found | Use the complete repository URL above. This package is not published to npm; its package name or `@latest` is not an installation source. |
| GitHub download fails | Open **Show install details**, check GitHub connectivity, and retry. Changing the npm registry does not fix GitHub access. Use the ZIP option if you can download it separately. |
| Installed, but no Dock | Enable it under **Installed plugins** and follow any restart notice. If activation fails, copy the diagnostic. |
| Wrong host or invalid directory | Update Dock to `0.1.2` for Harness `0.2.2-rc.1`; `0.2.1-rc.5` remains supported. An older installed Dock copy retains its old version restriction. For local installation, select the root containing `package.json` and `cordis.patch.yml`, with the full extracted contents intact. |

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Update or remove：[Report an issue](https://github.com/captainyufei/dsh-dock/issues) with your Harness/macOS versions, source entered, and installation error. Remove private paths or tokens from logs before posting.

</details>

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Everyday controls：Right-click the Dock to select registered entries, then drag icons to reorder them. Home stays first; up to six entries appear directly, with the rest under **More**. Preferences stay local. Right-click a chat for the host's pin, rename, fork, archive/unarchive, and copy Session ID actions; `Shift+F10` and the menu key work too.

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Everyday controls：Files, terminal, browser, tool tabs, and scheduled tasks are Harness capabilities. DeepSeek Dock adds their surrounding UI and video previews; it does not add a task execution engine.

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Drafts and input：Select a workspace, mode, model, and permissions before composing. Draft text and options survive page navigation and refresh; attachments must be reselected after refresh.

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Drafts and input：`Enter` sends and `Shift+Enter` inserts a newline. Confirming an IME composition does not send. Use `+` for local files, `@` for file paths or loaded chats, and the microphone for the host voice component. Attachments are handed to the host only on send. Failed sends retain the draft; uncertain results are not automatically retried.

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Restore tools and play videos：Native file tabs preview MP4, M4V, MOV, and WebM with pause, seeking, volume, and fullscreen controls, subject to the codec limits below.

The top-right button restores existing tool tabs. If the active chat has no tabs, it opens the native tool area. The new-tool or chat-selection entry appears only when there is neither an active chat nor restorable content.

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Restore tools and play videos：Collapsing the drawer, switching tabs, or closing the preview pauses playback and releases temporary media. Reopening within the same tab lifecycle and unchanged file version can restore the position **without autoplay**. Native keyboard controls and focus indicators remain available; window transitions respect reduced-motion preferences.

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Compatibility and limits：| Area | Current scope |
|---|---|
| **Host and platform** | Supported host versions are `0.2.1-rc.5` and `0.2.2-rc.1` on macOS. The original feature baseline was validated on `0.2.1-rc.5`; the `0.2.2-rc.1` upgrade check covers installation, loading, Dock collapse/customization, drafts, page navigation, and tool-drawer controls. Other operating systems, dark mode, and very narrow windows have not been fully tested on-device. |
| **Video codecs** | Recognizing an extension does not guarantee that every codec decodes. Support depends on the system/browser; H.264/AAC MP4 has been tested. Unsupported files can open in a system application. |
| **Desktop video size** | Desktop reads a complete temporary Blob before playback. Cached and in-flight media bytes share a **256 MiB** budget, with external opening available above it. This is not a process peak-memory cap. |
| **Playback position** | Restoration is limited to the same tool tab lifecycle and file version, not guaranteed after an app restart. |
| **Drafts and voice** | Attachments do not survive refresh. Voice requires the host component and local recognition resources. `/`

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Compatibility and limits：Version `0.1.2` remains an early `0.x` release. Compatibility is explicitly limited to the two host versions above; a newer Harness release needs renewed validation.

Hiding pinned chats can reduce the visible row count on a native group's first page. Expand the group to see more. The plugin uses host slots, services, and some DOM structure; host upgrades require renewed validation and are not automatically compatible.

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · Development and contributions：Run from the source repository root:

```sh
npm ci
npm test
npm run build:client
```

`npm test` builds before running tests; the runtime shares the host's React. Rebuild `dist/client.js` after editing source, then load the update through the host. Test results should come from the current commit's actual run; the simulated demo does not replace functional acceptance.

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · 功能：| 特点 | 日常使用有什么变化 |
|---|---|
| **左侧常驻、自定义 Dock** | 收起会话列表后，仍可直接切换首页、自动化任务和插件。选择常用入口，拖动调整顺序，按自己的习惯摆放。 |
| **Codex 风格 UI** | 首页、会话、插件和自动化任务页共用窗口外框及可拖动顶栏。切页时沿用同一套导航和工具控制，保留 DeepSeek 品牌与原生会话层级。 |
| **跨工作区会话置顶** | 重要会话集中到顶部，查找时不用逐个展开工作区。同一会话只显示一次；取消置顶后回到原组，工作区归属不变。 |
| **发送时才创建会话的草稿首页** | 先输入、修改，再决定是否发送。真正发送消息时才创建会话，未发送的想法不会让侧栏多出空会话。 |
| **右侧文件面板预览视频** | 在右侧直接播放、拖动视频进度，同时核对旁边的对话要求。再次展开工具抽屉会恢复已有标签，继续查看原内容。 |

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · 安装：需要 **macOS / Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 或 0.2.2-rc.1**。若装有旧版 `@local/chatgpt-rail`，先停用它（[迁移说明](docs/MIGRATION.md)）。本插件尚未发布到 npm，请使用下面的仓库地址，无需自行编译。

这会安装 `main` 上的最新代码，不等同于最新稳定发布版。已安装的副本不会自动更新。

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · 在 DeepSeek Harness 中安装：打开 **插件 → 添加插件**，将以下内容粘贴到 **包名或地址**，点击 **安装**： ```text https://github.com/captainyufei/dsh-dock ``` 出现 **已安装** 后，点击 **立即启用**。直接关闭窗口会让插件保持关闭。 在 **已安装插件** 中确认 **DeepSeek Dock** 已开启。收起会话列表，首页、自动化任务和插件入口应仍显示在左侧 Dock；右键 Dock 可自定义入口。
section: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中安装

text:
@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · 使用 `dsh` CLI 安装：安装到 **web profile**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/captainyufei/dsh-dock
```

若 Web UI 尚未运行，执行 `dsh web` 启动，再打开 **插件** 确认 DeepSeek Dock 已启用。此命令针对 web profile；桌面版请使用上面的安装窗口。

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · 更新或移除：先保存工作。若插件管理器提供 DeepSeek Dock 的 **更新** 按钮，直接更新，再按提示重新加载或重启。否则卸载后，使用上面同一仓库地址或 CLI 命令重新安装并启用。在详情中确认版本为 **0.1.2 或更新版本**；仅重新打开 Harness 不会下载新代码。

暂时不用时关闭开关；彻底移除时卸载后不再安装。两种操作都保留宿主管理的会话和工作区。

<details>
<summary>备用方式：从本地 ZIP 安装</summary>

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · 更新或移除：1. [下载当前 main 分支](https://github.com/captainyufei/dsh-dock/archive/refs/heads/main.zip)，解压到准备长期保留的目录。这是下载时的 `main` 快照，不是固定发布版本。
2. 找到包含 `package.json` 和 `cordis.patch.yml` 的根目录，保留完整解压内容及全部子目录。
3. 在访达中选中该文件夹，按 **Option–Command–C** 复制绝对路径，粘贴到 **插件 → 添加插件**。例如，用户名为 `alex` 时，路径可能是：

```text
   /Users/alex/Plugins/dsh-dock
   ```

请使用你实际保存的文件夹路径，不要原样填示例或选择 ZIP 文件。
4. 点击 **安装 → 立即启用**，再按上面的方法检查 Dock。安装后请保留本地目录。

</details>

<details>
<summary>安装遇到问题？展开排查</summary>

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · 更新或移除：| 问题 | 下一步 |
|---|---|
| 找不到包 | 使用上面的完整仓库地址。本包尚未发布到 npm，不能只填包名或 `@latest` 安装。 |
| GitHub 下载失败 | 打开 **查看安装详情**，检查 GitHub 连接后重试。切换 npm 安装源不能修复 GitHub 连接；能单独下载时可用 ZIP 方式。 |
| 已安装但 Dock 没出现 | 在 **已安装插件** 中启用，并按提示重启。若启用失败，复制诊断信息。 |
| 宿主不匹配或目录无效 | Harness `0.2.2-rc.1` 需将 Dock 更新至 `0.1.2`；仍支持 `0.2.1-rc.5`。旧版已安装副本仍带有原来的版本限制。本地安装时选中含 `package.json` 和 `cordis.patch.yml` 的根目录，确保解压内容完整。 |

[提交 issue](https://github.com/captainyufei/dsh-dock/issues) 时附 Harness/macOS 版本、填写的来源和安装错误；发布日志前删去私人路径或令牌。

</details>

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · 日常操作：右键 Dock 可选择已注册入口，直接拖动图标排序。首页固定第一；最多直接显示 6 项，其余进入“更多”，偏好保存在本机。右键会话可使用宿主的置顶、重命名、分叉、归档/取消归档和复制 Session ID；也支持 `Shift+F10` 或菜单键。

文件、终端、浏览器、工具标签和自动化任务由 Harness 提供。DeepSeek Dock 增强其外围界面并加入视频预览，不提供新的任务执行引擎。

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · 草稿与输入：输入前可选择工作区、模式、模型和权限。切页或刷新后，草稿文字与选项可恢复；附件在刷新后需要重新选择。

`Enter` 发送，`Shift+Enter` 换行；中文输入法选词时的回车不会发送。`+` 选择本地文件，`@` 引用文件路径或已加载会话，麦克风复用宿主语音组件。附件只在发送时交给宿主。发送失败保留草稿，结果不明确时不会自动重发。

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · 兼容与限制：| 项目 | 当前范围 |
|---|---|
| **宿主与平台** | 支持 macOS / Harness `0.2.1-rc.5` 和 `0.2.2-rc.1`。完整功能基线在旧版验证；新版升级验收覆盖安装、加载、Dock 折叠与自定义、草稿保留、页面切换及工具抽屉控制。其他系统、深色模式和极窄窗口未全面实机验证。 |
| **视频编码** | 扩展名识别不等于所有编码可解码；实际取决于系统/浏览器。已有 H.264/AAC MP4 实测，失败时可用系统应用打开。 |
| **桌面视频体积** | 桌面端先完整读取临时 Blob；缓存和在途媒体字节共享 **256 MiB** 预算，超限可外部打开。这不是进程内存峰值上限。 |
| **播放进度** | 恢复限于同一工具标签生命周期和同一文件版本，不保证应用重启后续播。 |
| **草稿与语音** | 附件不跨刷新保留。语音需宿主组件和本机识别资源；`/` 命令及 `@` 候选取决于宿主目录和权限。 |
| **语言** | README 提供中英文；部分新增界面文案仍为中文，尚未完成全界面国际化。 |

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · 兼容与限制：`0.1.2` 仍属于早期 `0.x` 版本；兼容范围明确限制为上述两个宿主版本，后续 Harness 更新仍需重新验证。

置顶会话被隐藏后，原生分组首屏可见行数可能减少；继续展开可查看后续会话。插件使用宿主槽位、服务及部分 DOM 结构，宿主升级后需重新验证，不能保证未来版本自动兼容。

@captainyufei/dsh-dock README · 开发与贡献：在源码仓库根目录执行：

```sh
npm ci
npm test
npm run build:client
```

`npm test` 会先构建再运行测试；运行时共享宿主 React。修改源码后需要重新构建 `dist/client.js`，并通过宿主加载更新。测试结果应以当前提交的实际运行记录为准，模拟演示不代替功能验收。
